title: Make paper with me - Cottage Vlog
en: salutations welcome to the cottage fairy today i will be making my own paper and wanted to give you some insight into the process it's quite simple slow and meditative a beautiful way to reuse paper scraps and consequently reduce waste learning new crafts is very important to me i'm always trying out new ideas and projects working with your hands in order to create something either useful or beautiful is always so exciting in the case of paper making i create something that is both traditional and nature-based crafts hold a special place in my heart in a world where fast fashion is mainstream where you often only find factory made products on store shelves becoming an artisan changes you as a consumer it gives you insight into the process of creating forming a story behind the end result

i find my home feels far more meaningful filled with things that i have created myself learning new crafts brings me joy because it teaches me patience acquiring a skill takes time and whatever you create is made more meaningful because you created it do

do with each attempt i will become more skilled the results more sophisticated and my efforts rewarded but all this takes patience in the meantime i enjoy the excitement of learning do so closed captioning sometimes my projects don't work out like i imagined there is something that goes straight into the compost but that's why i

started this channel to embrace the process of creating no matter the result i wanted to share my passion for making beauty or trying to make beauty in alignment with nature be it through art or crafts cooking or simply living my dream i am an artist and consequently like to make artistic videos through lovely images of my home i want to send out peaceful thoughts and hope and faith that anything is possible and that life can be if you choose full of joy and meaning so do

after a long day i find no greater gift of care you can give yourself than a homemade meal i struggle to have thoughtful sit-down meals and using my own vegetables and herbs motivates me to slow down focus on my senses and truly appreciate the gift of an abundant harvest you
zh: 向小屋仙女致意，今天我将制作自己的纸张，并希望给您一些关于这个过程的见解，它非常简单，缓慢且冥想，是一种重复使用纸屑的美丽方式，从而减少浪费学习新工艺品对我来说非常重要我总是尝试新的想法和项目，用你的双手创造出有用或美丽的东西在造纸的情况下总是如此令人兴奋我创造了一些既传统又基于自然的工艺品在快时尚的世界中在我心中占有特殊的地位主流，你通常只能在商店货架上找到工厂制造的产品，成为一名工匠会改变你作为消费者的身份，它让你深入了解创造的过程，形成最终结果背后的故事
我发现我的家感觉更有意义，充满了我自己创造的东西，学习新工艺给我带来快乐，因为它教会我耐心，获得技能需要时间，无论你创造什么，都会变得更有意义，因为你创造了它
每次尝试，我都会变得更加熟练，结果会更加复杂，我的努力会得到回报，但所有这一切都需要耐心，同时我享受学习的兴奋，这样做有时我的项目不会像我想象的那样成功，有一些东西会直接进入堆肥，但这就是为什么我
开始这个频道是为了拥抱创造的过程，无论结果如何，我想分享我对创造美的热情，或试图让美与自然保持一致，无论是通过艺术或手工艺烹饪，还是只是实现我的梦想，我是一名艺术家，因此喜欢通过我家的可爱图像制作艺术视频，我想发出平静的想法、希望和信念，相信一切皆有可能，如果你选择充满欢乐和意义，生活就可以成为现实。
经过漫长的一天后，我发现没有什么比一顿自制的饭菜更能给予自己关怀的礼物了，我很难坐下来吃周到的饭菜，而使用自己的蔬菜和香草促使我放慢对感官的关注，真正欣赏丰收的礼物
